accept-calendar-event.why: Accepts invite, sending optional comment to organiser.

add-calendar-event-attachment.why: Attaches file to an event; not sent until updated (hard call).

add-excel-table-rows.why: Writes rows into a workbook table privately.

add-group-member.why: Adds a group member; membership change, no content sent.

add-group-owner.why: Adds a group owner; access change only.

add-mail-attachment.why: Adds attachment to a message or draft privately.

cancel-calendar-event.why: Cancels meeting with custom message sent to attendees.

copilot-retrieve.why: Semantic search across mail, files and chats, permission-trimmed.

copy-drive-item.why: Copies a drive item to a new location privately.

copy-mail-message.why: Copies a message to another folder.

create-calendar-event.why: Creates event that sends invitations to attendees.

create-calendar-event-attachment-upload-.why: Creates upload session to attach large file to event (hard call).

create-chat.why: Creates chat object from members; no message text sent (hard call).

create-contact-in-folder.why: Creates a contact in a folder.

create-drive-item-preview.why: Creates embeddable preview link to a private file, usable for sharing (hard call).

create-drive-item-share-link.why: Creates a sharing link that outsiders can open.

create-excel-chart.why: Creates a chart inside a workbook.

create-excel-table.why: Converts a range into a table.

create-focused-inbox-override.why: Creates Focused Inbox override; private mail setting.

create-group.why: Creates a group with no message content.

create-mail-attachment-upload-session.why: Creates upload session for attaching large file to a draft.

create-mail-rule.why: Creates mail rule that can forward mail to agent-chosen address.

create-my-calendar-permission.why: Shares the user's calendar with another user (hard call).

create-onedrive-folder.why: Creates a private folder with a name.

create-onenote-page.why: Creates a private OneNote page in default notebook.

create-onenote-section.why: Creates a section in a notebook.

create-specific-calendar-event.why: Creates event that can invite attendees with agent-chosen text.

create-upload-session.why: Creates upload URL for the caller to write private bytes (hard call).

decline-calendar-event.why: Declines invite, sending optional comment to organiser.

delete-calendar-event.why: Deletes event; no agent text sent.

delete-drive-item-permission.why: Removes a permission; access change without outbound content.

delete-mail-folder.why: Deletes a mail folder and contents.

delete-mail-message-skip-deleted-items.why: Deletes a message without moving to Deleted Items.

delete-onedrive-file.why: Deletes a OneDrive file; no content sent.

delete-specific-calendar-event.why: Deletes an event; no agent text sent (may notify attendees).

dismiss-calendar-event-reminder.why: Dismisses a reminder; no content sent.

extract-drive-item-sensitivity-labels.why: Reads sensitivity labels assigned to a private file.

find-meeting-times.why: Suggests meeting times from attendees' availability.

format-excel-range.why: Sets alignment and sizing on a range.

format-excel-range-border.why: Sets a border side on a range.

format-excel-range-fill.why: Sets background fill on a range.

format-excel-range-font.why: Sets font styling on a range.

forward-calendar-event.why: Forwards meeting invitation to new recipients.

forward-mail-message.why: Forwards a message to agent-chosen recipients.

get-adhoc-call-transcript-content.why: Returns call transcript text containing other speakers' words.

get-calendar-event.why: Reads one event, which others may have written.

get-calendar-view.why: Reads calendar view for a date range.

get-chat.why: Returns a private chat's metadata and members.

get-chat-message.why: Reads a single chat message written by others.

get-drive-delta.why: Lists changed drive items and their metadata over time.

get-drive-item.why: Returns a file's metadata including owner and download URL.

get-drive-root-item.why: Returns a drive's root folder metadata.

get-excel-range.why: Reads cell values in a workbook others may edit.

get-excel-range-format.why: Reads range formatting, which can encode private status meaning.

get-excel-table.why: Reads one workbook table's structure and style.

get-excel-used-range.why: Reads populated cell values and formulas in a worksheet.

get-group-calendar-view.why: Reads group calendar events, which others may invite into.

get-mail-attachment-content.why: Downloads attachment bytes from a received email.

get-mail-message.why: Reads full email content written by others.

get-mail-message-mime.why: Downloads raw MIME of an email, including others' content.

get-mail-tips.why: Looks up recipients' mailtips including others' auto-reply text.

get-mailbox-settings.why: Reads the user's mailbox settings including time zone.

get-my-manager.why: Returns the user's manager from directory.

get-onenote-notebook-from-web-url.why: Resolves a notebook from its web URL.

get-presences-by-user-id.why: Returns presence status for many users.

get-schedule.why: Returns free/busy availability for people or rooms.

get-sensitivity-label.why: Reads one org sensitivity label definition.

get-specific-calendar-event.why: Reads one calendar event, which others may have written.

get-specific-calendar-view.why: Reads calendar events in a range, some from others' invites.

graph-batch.why: Arbitrary Graph requests in one call; can read private data and send mail.

insert-excel-range.why: Inserts blank cells into a workbook.

list-accounts.why: Lists the user's own account emails, which are private identifiers.

list-adhoc-call-transcripts.why: Lists ad hoc call transcript metadata for the user.

list-calendar-event-instances.why: Lists event occurrences in a date range.

list-calendar-events.why: Lists calendar events; some from others' invites.

list-calendar-events-delta.why: Delta sync of events in a calendar view.

list-calendar-view-delta.why: Delta sync of calendar view events.

list-calendars.why: Lists the user's calendars by name.

list-chat-members.why: Lists chat members with emails and roles.

list-chat-message-hosted-contents.why: Lists images and snippets attached to chat messages from others.

list-chat-message-replies.why: Reads replies to chat messages written by others.

list-chat-messages.why: Reads private chat messages written by other participants.

list-chats.why: Lists chats with last message previews from others.

list-drive-item-permissions.why: Lists who has access to a file, including sharing links.

list-drive-item-thumbnails.why: Lists thumbnail URLs for drive files.

list-drive-item-versions.why: Lists version history metadata for a file.

list-drives.why: Lists drives for a user, group or site.

list-excel-table-rows.why: Reads workbook table rows, which others may have edited.

list-excel-tables.why: Lists named tables in a workbook.

list-excel-worksheets.why: Lists worksheet names in a workbook.

list-focused-inbox-overrides.why: Lists Focused Inbox sender overrides for the user.

list-folder-files.why: Lists file and folder metadata in a drive folder.

list-group-conversations.why: Lists group conversation threads from members.

list-group-events.why: Lists group events, which others may have created.

list-group-planner-plans.why: Lists planner plans owned by a group.

list-group-threads.why: Lists group threads posted by members.

list-joined-teams.why: Lists joined Teams the user belongs to.

list-mail-attachments.why: Lists attachment names and types on a message.

list-mail-folder-messages.why: Searches and lists messages in a folder from others.

list-mail-folder-messages-delta.why: Delta sync of messages in a folder.

list-mail-messages.why: Lists and searches email from others with previews.

list-mail-rules.why: Lists inbox rules including forwarding targets.

list-my-calendar-permissions.why: Lists who the calendar is shared with.

list-my-direct-reports.why: Lists the user's direct reports from directory.

list-my-memberships.why: Lists groups and roles the user belongs to.

list-onenote-pages.why: Lists OneNote page titles and metadata across notebooks.

list-pinned-chat-messages.why: Lists pinned chat messages written by participants.

list-sensitivity-labels.why: Lists org sensitivity label definitions, organisation config not personal.

list-specific-calendar-events.why: Lists calendar events, some created from others' invites.

list-trending-insights.why: Lists trending documents around the user with titles.

login.why: Interactive sign-in; no mailbox or profile data returned.

logout.why: Signs out; no data returned or sent.

move-rename-onedrive-item.why: Moves or renames a OneDrive item; no content sent.

pin-chat-message.why: Pins an existing message; no new text sent.

remove-account.why: Removes cached account; no content read or sent.

remove-group-member.why: Removes a group member; membership change, no content.

remove-group-owner.why: Removes a group owner; access change only.

reply-all-mail-message.why: Replies to all recipients with agent-written text.

reply-mail-message.why: Replies to sender with agent-written text.

reply-to-chat-message.why: Posts a reply into a chat visible to all members.

reply-to-group-thread.why: Posts a reply into a group thread visible to members.

search-onedrive-files.why: Searches file names and contents across drives.

select-account.why: Sets default account locally; no content read or sent.

send-chat-message.why: Posts agent-written message into a chat others can read.

send-draft-message.why: Sends an existing draft message to its recipients.

set-chat-message-reaction.why: Sets an emoji reaction; no free text sent.

share-drive-item.why: Shares a file with recipients and can send them an email.

snooze-calendar-event-reminder.why: Postpones a reminder; no content sent.

sort-excel-range.why: Sorts a range in a workbook.

tentatively-accept-calendar-event.why: Tentatively accepts, sending optional comment to organiser.

unpin-chat-message.why: Unpins a message; status change only.

unset-chat-message-reaction.why: Removes an emoji reaction; no free text sent.

update-calendar-event.why: Updates event; attendee changes notify outside invitees.

update-chat-message.why: Edits a sent chat message, replacing agent text visible to members.

update-contact-folder.why: Renames or moves a contact folder.

update-excel-range.why: Writes cell values into a workbook.

update-mail-message.why: Marks, flags or edits a message or draft; no send.

update-mail-rule.why: Updates mail rule; can set forwarding to an agent-chosen address.

update-mailbox-settings.why: Sets out-of-office replies that auto-send agent text to outside senders.

update-my-calendar-permission.why: Changes share role; access change, no content sent.

update-specific-calendar-event.why: Updates event; setting attendees sends invitations.

upload-file-content.why: Writes file bytes to OneDrive; private write.

verify-login.why: Reports sign-in status only, no content.
